task_instance: Attempt to scaffold and build a minimal macOS native app that embeds the Zoom Meeting SDK (custom UI join flow) as described by the zoom-meeting-sdk-macos skill, using the skill's referenced macOS project setup and SDK auth (PKCE + SDK JWT) pattern.
blocker_detail: The skill's core deliverable is a native macOS application (Xcode project, Objective-C/Swift, AppKit) embedding Apple's macOS-only Zoom Meeting SDK framework. This runtime is Linux (Ubuntu 24.04, uname -a confirms x86_64 GNU/Linux), not macOS: there is no Xcode, no `xcodebuild`, and no `swiftc` toolchain (checked via `which xcodebuild clang swiftc` -> only generic `clang` present, no Apple toolchain). macOS app development and the Zoom Meeting SDK for macOS (.xcframework, distributed as a proprietary binary via a Zoom Marketplace developer account) cannot be built, linked, or run on Linux at all -- this is not a package that could be installed, it is a fundamentally different OS/toolchain the runtime does not provide. Additionally, the skill's own referenced files (macos.md, concepts/, examples/, scenarios/, references/, troubleshooting/, RUNBOOK.md) are absent from the shipped skill directory -- only SKILL.md and LICENSE exist -- so even the setup instructions themselves are not present to follow. I stopped after confirming the OS/toolchain mismatch and the missing reference docs, without attempting any workaround (e.g. cross-compiling or emulating macOS), per the safety rules.
evidence: Ran `ls /home/user/skill-achievability-compiler/benchmark/ce_sources_div/anthropics__knowledge-work-plugins__macos/` -> only LICENSE and SKILL.md exist; all 9 files listed under 'Start Here' in SKILL.md (macos.md, concepts/lifecycle-workflow.md, concepts/architecture.md, examples/join-start-pattern.md, scenarios/high-level-scenarios.md, references/macos-reference-map.md, references/environment-variables.md, references/versioning-and-compatibility.md, troubleshooting/common-issues.md, RUNBOOK.md) are missing. Ran `uname -a` -> 'Linux vm 6.18.44-fc-v37 ... x86_64 GNU/Linux'. Ran `which xcodebuild clang swiftc` -> only /usr/bin/clang found; xcodebuild and swiftc absent. Ran `cat /etc/os-release` -> Ubuntu 24.04.4 LTS. Concluded the skill's stated deliverable (a macOS native app using the Zoom Meeting SDK for macOS) cannot be attempted in this Linux runtime, independent of the missing reference docs or any Zoom developer credentials that would also be required.
